$comment: Mapping used by the figma-sync agent. This Figma file is COMPONENT-FIRST: reusable UI lives as local Figma components on the '💠 Components' page (componentsPage below), and screens are ASSEMBLIES OF INSTANCES of those components — never duplicated raw layers. When an app element is reused, the agent reuses (or creates) a component on that page, then instances it. node ids use the ':' form (384:80); the URL uses '384-80'. knownComponents is a HINT captured on 2026-07-10 — the live page (get_metadata 384:80) is always the source of truth.

componentsPage.name: 💠 Components
componentsPage.$comment: Home of every reusable local component. Place a NEW component in the section matching its kind. ALWAYS reuse an existing component (match by name) before creating a duplicate. Refreshed 2026-09-16 against the live page; the Modal — * entries listed before that date are NOT on this page and could not be resolved.

framesComment: The maintained SCREEN frames, all on the 'UI' page (0:1) as full 1440-wide assemblies — distinct from the mockups on the '💠 Components' page (e.g. the 'Session — Central thread' assembly 618:759 there is NOT the maintained session; 643:4812 is). Each is an assembly of component instances — sync by (re)instancing components per the isolation rules, never by editing raw layers. Node ids re-verified against the live file on 2026-09-16.

contexts.name: Playbooks
contexts.note: Playbooks LIST page. Sidebar + Topbar + head (title/sub + DS Form - Search + 'Create a Playbook' primary blue) + a 3-COLUMN grid of 'Playbook Card' instances (344x244 native) + the ghost 'Create a Playbook' card. Rendered by home.js since the /contexts + /home merge.

playbook.name: Playbook detail
playbook.note: Playbook DETAIL page (Sidebar + Topbar + rail + Recap Panel components). Rail has FOUR sections (Audience & goals / Voice & style / Brand / Competitors — playbookCompetitors is baked ON). Audience & goals opens on a Language row. The monogram tile carries the brand logo SVG (assets/logos/brands/*.svg), with the initials as the app's fallback.

session.name: Session
session.note: Main chat surface — largest screen. Shown with the Sources right panel OPEN: thread column 570 + panel 610. Also touches src/screens/session/*, chat.css. The 'Chat — Drafts Card' turn is kept on purpose: the seeded chat no longer ends on one, but draft-flow produces it in this very chat.

session-new-chat.name: Session — New chat
session-new-chat.note: First-run empty hero (renderEmptyHero), rendered with NO topbar — the app hides it on the solo hero. Sidebar (Expanded) + centered hero = Archie wordmark + subtitle + Composer Card (740 wide, 'Playbook chevron' ON because the select is enabled on a new chat) + hint + 'Jump into a workflow' label + starter-grid of 3 'Starter Card' instances (331x126 native, gap 12). Starter Card is a LOCAL hand-built component (no DS 'workflow card') with Title/Subtitle/CTA text props + Art INSTANCE_SWAP; watermarks are V2 Icons.

top-posts-board.name: Top Posts — Board
top-posts-board.route: #/session/:id — 'Use top performing posts' starter, after the account pick
top-posts-board.note: FULL-PAGE board (no longer an in-thread board): intro badge/title/sub + 3 'Workflow Step' instances + toolbar (count + Period/Sort as real DS 'Form - Select' instances) + a 3-col grid of Top Post Card instances (316x405 native). The Period/Sort stand-in Buttons were replaced on 2026-09-16. A separate ACCOUNT-PICKER stage precedes this board and has no frame yet.

batch-studio.name: Batch Studio
batch-studio.note: Full-page 'Batch from a source' takeover: Sidebar + Topbar + 1000px column = 'Batch' AI badge + title/sub + 3 'Workflow Step' instances + a bordered card holding a 'Dropzone — Large' instance and the 'Or add another way' row + a flex-end commit row (DS Form - Select + orange primary). FLAG: the AI badge is still hand-built (no DS AI-badge component).

clip-studio.name: Clip Studio
clip-studio.note: Full-screen clip review/editor (clips stage): Sidebar + Topbar + head (Back to setup + 'Clips ready' AI badge + title + subtitle) + review settings (Output format + Caption style button rows) + wrapping grid of Clip Card instances each with a DS Checkbox selection overlay + docked bottom bar (Add clip / N selected / Continue). Upload stage exists separately as 'Clip Studio - Setup' (924:52). FLAG: format/caption selectors are DS Buttons standing in for the app's ratio-shape/caption-preview cards; AI badge hand-built.

clip-studio-setup.name: Clip Studio — Setup
clip-studio-setup.note: Auto Clips setup, ANALYZING state. 1000px column: intro + 3 Workflow Steps + card [left: analyzing preview + filename row + 'or' + URL row (Form - Input + Import); right: Clip duration Form - Select + Additional instructions Form - Textarea] + flex-end commit row (Form - Select + 'Find clip ideas'). FLAG: the video-preview illustration is hand-built with decorative literal colours (not DS tokens).

clip-studio-setup-upload.name: Clip Studio — Setup (Upload)
clip-studio-setup-upload.route: #/session/clip-studio-* (initial upload state, before a video is added)
clip-studio-setup-upload.source: src/clip-studio.js + src/screens/session.js (renderClipStudio config, leftPanel = dropzone branch)
clip-studio-setup-upload.note: Initial UPLOAD state of the Auto Clips setup. Same chassis as 'Clip Studio — Setup'; only the left column differs — a 'Dropzone — Large' instance (530x251) instead of the analyzing preview.

connectors.name: Connectors
connectors.note: Connectors gallery. Full assembly: Sidebar + Topbar (title 'Connectors') + hero (title/subtitle + DS Status count pill) + toolbar (DS Form-Search + DS Tag category chips) + 6 category groups of 'Connector Card' instances (set 1233:2255; State=Default/Connected). Logos use accent monogram tiles (code fallback), not brand SVGs. Detail/empty/mobile not built. Feature gated behind the `connectors` flag (OFF by default) in the app. NOT synced on 2026-09-16: the `connectors` flag is OFF by default, so /connectors is unreachable in the flags-OFF app state the sync was run against.

clip-studio (clips review).$comment: Listed in this manifest until 2026-09-16 but absent from the live file — the frame was deleted at some point. The clips-review stage of the Clip Studio has no frame.
